summary.result: We also found that incorporating the estimated risk attitudes results in substantial differences in the impacts of the rice paddy conversion policy.
summary.background: The purpose of this study is constructing a regional-level crop acreage choice model incorporating the impacts of producer risk aversion, and applying the constructed model to the Korean policy that promotes rice paddy conversion into non-rice crop fields.
summary.method: The study adopts the approach of Paris (2018) which estimates the absolute risk aversion coefficient inside of a positive mathematical programming model.
